species.name: Crappie
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 1–14 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 60°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 1–10 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
